title: Crepes

steps.text: Throw all the above ingredients in a blender (or food processor, or mix well by hand). Transfer batter to a covered container and store in the refrigerator at least 1/2 hour and up to 48 hours.

Gently stir up batter, it should be slightly thicker than heavy cream. Heat a 7-8 in crepe pan or small heavy skillet over medium-high heat. Brush the bottom with melted butter or vegetable oil. When pan is hot, pour in 2 1/2 tablespoons batter, swirl pan to coat evenly. Cook 30 seconds to 1 minute until mottled brown on the bottom, loosen the crepe and flip. Cook another 30 seconds on the other side. For a 9 - 10in skillet use 1/4 cup batter.

If not eaten right away, crepes can be double-wrapped in plastic and refrigerated up to 3 days or frozen up to 2 months. To freeze, stack up 8 crepes, wrap in plastic wrap, then in foil, for several weeks. To thaw, switch them from the freezer, directly to the refrigerator. This will take about 3 hours.

notes: *If using low-fat milk, replace both whole milk and water with low-fat milk.
